title: Agri‐Food Policymaking in More Turbulent Times: Reflections at the Centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society
title_zh: 动荡时期中的农业食品政策制定：农业经济学学会百年反思
title_primary: 动荡时期中的农业食品政策制定：农业经济学学会百年反思
title_secondary: Agri‐Food Policymaking in More Turbulent Times: Reflections at the Centenary of the Agricultural Economics Society
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural and food policy is increasingly shaped by geopolitical instability, ecological constraints, technological disruption, political polarisation and declining trust in expertise. At the same time, calls for food system transformation have gained prominence as evidence accumulates on the environmental, health and social shortcomings of current food systems. Yet reform has frequently stalled despite extensive scientific analysis and broad recognition of the need for change. This paper examines why. After reviewing some traditional explanations for policy persistence, the paper introduces the concept of policy ontologies: underlying ways of understanding what the food system is, how it functions, what it is ultimately for and how change occurs. Three ideal‐type ontologies are identified: a productivity ontology, a power‐focused ontology and an ecological ontology. These ontologies shape the definition of policy problems and the selection of preferred policy responses, helping to explain why stakeholders often appear to talk past one another. As the Society begins its second century in a more turbulent and contested policy environment, the profession's central role remains the production of rigorous evidence. That contribution will be strengthened by a greater awareness of the different ways in which food systems are understood and of how these perspectives shape both policy debates and the interpretation of evidence. Recognising these underlying assumptions can help agricultural economists contribute more effectively to policy debate as honest brokers of policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 农业与食品政策日益受到地缘政治不稳定、生态约束、技术颠覆、政治极化以及对专业知识信任度下降的影响。与此同时，随着关于当前食品体系在环境、健康和社会方面缺陷的证据不断积累，要求食品体系转型的呼声日益高涨。然而，尽管有广泛的科学分析和变革必要性的普遍共识，改革却常常陷入停滞。本文探讨了其中的原因。在回顾了关于政策持续性的传统解释之后，本文引入了政策本体论的概念：即对食品体系是什么、如何运作、其最终目的以及变革如何发生的基本理解方式。本文识别出三种理想类型的本体论：生产力本体论、权力聚焦本体论和生态本体论。这些本体论塑造了政策问题的定义和首选政策响应的选择，有助于解释为何利益相关者常常看似在自说自话。随着学会在一个更加动荡和充满争议的政策环境中开启其第二个世纪，本专业的核心角色仍然是提供严谨的证据。通过增强对食品体系不同理解方式以及这些视角如何影响政策辩论和证据解读的认识，这一贡献将得到加强。认识到这些潜在的假设，有助于农业经济学家作为政策替代方案的诚实中间人，更有效地为政策辩论做出贡献。

title: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
title_zh: 将激励与信息挂钩：基于诊断的合同与医疗中的认知偏差
title_primary: 将激励与信息挂钩：基于诊断的合同与医疗中的认知偏差
title_secondary: Tying Incentives to Information: Diagnosis-Contingent Contracts and Biased Beliefs in Healthcare
authors: Maria Dieci, Paul Gertler, Jonathan T. Kolstad, Carlos Paramo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Unnecessary treatment reflects a gap between what patients believe about their health and their true condition; people often seek and consume care for diseases they suspect, but do not know that actually have. The value a patient places on testing therefore depends on their priors about being sick, and when those beliefs are biased, the resulting testing rate might be sub-optimal and leave welfare on the table. We study diagnosis-contingent incentive contracts, which tie treatment incentives to diagnostic results. For malaria, the contract subsidizes rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) and antimalarials (ACTs) only for patients who test positive. In a cluster-randomized experiment across 140 Kenyan pharmacies, both patient subsidies and provider incentives roughly tripled testing and sharply reduced unnecessary ACT purchases among test-negative patients, working through distinct channels: patient subsidies through lower prices, provider incentives through information and advice. A model of patient choice implies these contracts raise social welfare well above their cost. Estimating the model structurally, we find that because patients substantially overestimate their infection risk, loading incentives onto diagnosis-contingent treatment discounts delivers four times the welfare gains of free testing programs.
abstract_zh: 不必要的治疗反映了患者对自身健康状况的认知与其真实状况之间的差距；人们常常因怀疑自己患有某种疾病而寻求并接受医疗服务，但实际上并不知晓自己是否真的患病。因此，患者对检测的重视程度取决于其对患病可能性的先验信念，而当这些信念存在偏差时，由此产生的检测率可能并非最优，从而造成福利损失。我们研究了与诊断结果挂钩的激励合同，即将治疗激励与诊断结果相关联。针对疟疾，该合同仅对检测呈阳性的患者补贴快速诊断测试（RDTs）和青蒿素联合疗法（ACTs）。在一项覆盖肯尼亚140家药店的整群随机实验中，患者补贴和提供者激励均使检测率大约提高了两倍，并显著减少了检测阴性患者中不必要的ACT购买，二者通过不同渠道发挥作用：患者补贴通过降低价格，提供者激励则通过信息和建议。患者选择模型表明，这些合同带来的社会福利提升远超其成本。通过对模型进行结构化估计，我们发现，由于患者大幅高估其感染风险，将激励加载到基于诊断结果的治疗折扣上，其福利收益是免费检测项目的四倍。

title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用
title_primary: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用
title_secondary: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
abstract: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。

title: The Social Desirability Atlas
authors: Leonardo Bursztyn, Ingar Haaland, Nicolas Röver, Christopher Roth, William Parker 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we examine how SDB can distort treatment effects in experiments and discuss mitigation strategies. Translation created by Artificial Intelligence (LLM) #### Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn is a pervasive threat to the validity of survey and experimental data. Respondents might often misreport sensitive attitudes and behaviors to appear more socially acceptable. We begin by synthesizing empirical evidence on the prevalence and magnitude of SDB across various domains, focusing on studies with individual-level benchmarks. We then critically assess commonly used strategies to mitigate SDB, highlighting how they can sometimes fail by creating confusion or inadvertently increasing perceived sensitivity. To help researchers navigate these challenges, we offer practical guidance on selecting the most suitable tools for different research contexts. Finally, we examine how SDB can distort treatment effects in experiments and discuss mitigation strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了社会期望偏差（SDB）如何扭曲实验中的处理效应，并讨论了缓解策略。由人工智能（LLM）生成的翻译 #### 分享 Twitter Facebook LinkedIn 社会期望偏差（SDB）是调查与实验数据有效性的普遍威胁。受访者可能经常误报敏感态度和行为，以显得更符合社会期望。我们首先综合了各领域关于SDB普遍性与严重程度的实证证据，重点关注具有个体层面基准的研究。随后，我们批判性地评估了常用的SDB缓解策略，指出这些策略有时可能因造成混淆或无意中增加感知敏感性而失效。为帮助研究者应对这些挑战，我们提供了针对不同研究情境选择最合适工具的实际指导。最后，我们考察了SDB如何扭曲实验中的处理效应，并讨论了缓解策略。

title: Taxi Market Deregulation: Effects on Market Outcomes, Tax Evasion and Crime
title_zh: 出租车市场放松管制：对市场结果、逃税和犯罪的影响
title_primary: 出租车市场放松管制：对市场结果、逃税和犯罪的影响
title_secondary: Taxi Market Deregulation: Effects on Market Outcomes, Tax Evasion and Crime
authors: Jarkko Harju, Ida Kankaanranta, Kaisa Kotakorpi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects of taxi market deregulation in Finland, which removed price controls and lowered barriers to entry. The reform led to a surge in firm entry and a modest increase in exit, indicating substantial changes in market structure. Average taxi prices increased slightly according to price indices, while monthly firm-level reported sales and VAT declined by over 10 percent. Operating costs and mileage remained largely unchanged, suggesting limited demand responses. These findings point to increased tax evasion following deregulation. Consistent with this interpretation, we document a small rise in property crime, with no effects on other criminal offenses.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了芬兰出租车市场放松管制的影响，该改革取消了价格控制并降低了市场准入门槛。改革导致企业大量进入市场，退出数量略有增加，表明市场结构发生了显著变化。根据价格指数，出租车平均价格小幅上涨，而企业月度报告销售额和增值税下降了超过10%。运营成本和行驶里程基本保持不变，表明需求反应有限。这些发现表明放松管制后逃税行为有所增加。与这一解释一致，我们记录了财产犯罪的小幅上升，而对其他刑事犯罪没有影响。

title: Explaining The Equity Risk Premium
authors: Patrick Minford, Laurian Lungu, Ricardo Caballero, Alp Simsek, Yu-chin Chen 等
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a simple overlapping generations model in which the young have a choice in investing in equities and index-linked bonds. Projections of share price uncertainty over a 30-year period show that the risk associated with such a long-term investment predicts an equity premium that matches historical values.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简单的世代交叠模型，其中年轻人可以选择投资于股票和指数挂钩债券。对30年期内股价不确定性的预测表明，此类长期投资所伴随的风险所预测的股权溢价与历史数据吻合。

title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
title_zh: 金融制裁与全球支付网络
title_primary: 金融制裁与全球支付网络
title_secondary: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Financial sanctions are widely viewed as a powerful tool of economic statecraft, yet direct evidence on their effects remains limited. We study how sanctions affect access to global payment networks using data on correspondent banking relationships, which link banks across countries and currencies to enable cross-border transactions. We first show that the dollar and euro networks offer the broadest global connectivity, supported by a small number of key hubs in the U.S. and Europe. Sanctions that restrict access to these hubs are therefore potentially powerful. We then show how financial sanctions imposed during 2021-2025 – a period of rapid growth in sanctions – reduced targeted banks' access to major-currency networks by severing correspondent relationships. Sanctioned institutions often retained access but only through longer, indirect, and more fragile chains of intermediaries. Finally, in countries where sanctions expanded sharply, non-sanctioned banks also lost connectivity to Western networks, likely reflecting de-risking. These banks reoriented toward alternatives, particularly the Chinese yuan. Outside these heavily sanctioned economies, shifts away from the dollar and toward the yuan remain minimal on average.
abstract_zh: 金融制裁被广泛视为经济治国方略的有力工具，但其影响的直接证据仍然有限。我们利用代理行关系数据研究制裁如何影响全球支付网络的接入——这些关系将不同国家和货币的银行连接起来，以实现跨境交易。我们首先发现，美元和欧元网络提供了最广泛的全球连通性，这得益于美国和欧洲少数关键枢纽的支持。因此，限制这些枢纽接入的制裁具有潜在强大效力。随后，我们展示了2021-2025年间（制裁快速扩张时期）实施的金融制裁如何通过切断代理行关系，削弱目标银行对主要货币网络的接入。受制裁机构往往仍能保留接入渠道，但只能通过更长、间接且更脆弱的中间链条实现。最后，在制裁急剧扩大的国家，未受制裁的银行也失去了与西方网络的连通性，这很可能反映了去风险化行为。这些银行转向替代方案，尤其是人民币。而在这些受严重制裁的经济体之外，从美元转向人民币的总体变化仍微乎其微。

title: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
title_zh: 解释社会保障残疾保险参保率的历史上升与近期下降
title_primary: 解释社会保障残疾保险参保率的历史上升与近期下降
title_secondary: Explaining the Historical Rise and Recent Decline in Social Security Disability Insurance Enrollment
authors: Manasi Deshpande, Maxwell Kellogg, Magne Mogstad, Kuan-Ju Tseng
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: After substantial growth in the 1990s and 2000s, enrollment in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program has been declining since 2013. We use detailed administrative data to quantify the contributions of various factors to trends in SSDI enrollment, focusing especially on the decline in the 2010s. A statistical decomposition suggests that the vast majority of the decline in SSDI enrollment since 2013 is attributable to declines in application rates—and, to a lesser extent, award rates—within demographic groups. There is very little contribution from changes over time in demographic characteristics, eligibility, or exit from SSDI. The decline in SSDI enrollment rates is disproportionately driven by low-to-middle-skilled men who, over time, have become less likely to apply for SSDI and more likely to work. Consistent with this descriptive evidence, we present results from a causal analysis suggesting that improved labor market opportunity for less-skilled men is a key explanation for the decline in SSDI enrollment. We also investigate several other popular hypotheses for the decline in SSDI applications, including lower award rates at the appeals level, and find evidence at odds with them.
abstract_zh: 在1990年代和2000年代经历了显著增长后，美国社会保障残疾保险（SSDI）项目的参保人数自2013年起持续下降。我们利用详细的行政数据量化了各因素对SSDI参保趋势的贡献，重点关注2010年代的下降趋势。统计分解表明，2013年以来SSDI参保人数的下降绝大部分可归因于各人口群体内申请率的下降（以及较小程度上的批准率下降）。人口特征、资格条件或退出SSDI的时序变化对下降趋势的贡献微乎其微。SSDI参保率的下降主要由中低技能男性群体驱动——随着时间的推移，该群体申请SSDI的可能性降低，而就业可能性上升。与这一描述性证据一致，我们通过因果分析发现，低技能男性劳动力市场机会的改善是解释SSDI参保率下降的关键因素。我们还检验了其他几种关于SSDI申请下降的流行假说（包括上诉阶段批准率降低），但发现证据与之相悖。

title: Design matters: Independent fiscal institutions and the cyclicality of government spending
title_zh: 设计至关重要：独立财政机构与政府支出的周期性
title_primary: 设计至关重要：独立财政机构与政府支出的周期性
title_secondary: Design matters: Independent fiscal institutions and the cyclicality of government spending
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a panel of 157 countries over the period 2000–2022, we estimate time-varying coefficients of government spending cyclicality and examine whether independent fiscal institutions help reduce this cyclicality. Our findings indicate that the design features of independent fiscal institutions play a crucial role. Institutions with stronger mandates, broader responsibilities, greater independence, adequate resources, and effective communication frameworks are associated with more countercyclical fiscal policy.
abstract_zh: 利用2000年至2022年间157个国家的面板数据，我们估计了政府支出周期性的时变系数，并考察独立财政机构是否有助于降低这种周期性。研究结果显示，独立财政机构的设计特征至关重要。拥有更强授权、更广泛职责、更高独立性、充足资源及有效沟通框架的机构，与更具逆周期性的财政政策相关联。

title: Surveying the Farmer Survey: A Synthesis of Research Practices in the Netherlands, Slovenia and Sweden
title_zh: 农民调查综述：荷兰、斯洛文尼亚与瑞典的研究实践综合
title_primary: 农民调查综述：荷兰、斯洛文尼亚与瑞典的研究实践综合
title_secondary: Surveying the Farmer Survey: A Synthesis of Research Practices in the Netherlands, Slovenia and Sweden
authors: Thomas Slijper, Julia Höhler, Tanja Šumrada, Jens Rommel, Živa Alif, Jesus Barreiro‐Hurle 等
abstract: ABSTRACT Research based on farmer surveys is a cornerstone of agricultural economics. Farmer surveys provide unique insights into behavioural variables—such as values, motivations, attitudes, behaviours, and preferences—that are unavailable in secondary datasets. However, the decline in farm numbers across most European countries, combined with a growing number of surveys, is posing a threat to farmer survey research. This paper synthesises current practices in farmer surveys in the Netherlands, Slovenia, and Sweden. Our approach is meta‐scientific, drawing on a survey aimed at researchers responsible for 34 farmer surveys conducted between January 2019 and August 2024. This analysis is complemented by a document analysis and critical reflection workshops. We identify three key challenges: (i) limited consistency and standardisation of socio‐economic survey questions, (ii) long surveys, which are associated with high attrition and low response rates, and (iii) low adoption of open science practices. To address these challenges, we propose a set of best practices to enhance the transparency, comparability, standardisation, and reusability of farmer survey data. These best practices aim to strengthen the quality of survey‐based research in agricultural economics and ensure that farmer surveys continue to support evidence‐based policymaking.
abstract_zh: 摘要 基于农户调查的研究是农业经济学的基石。农户调查提供了关于行为变量（如价值观、动机、态度、行为和偏好）的独特见解，这些变量在二手数据集中无法获得。然而，大多数欧洲国家农户数量的下降，加之调查数量的不断增加，正对农户调查研究构成威胁。本文综合了荷兰、斯洛文尼亚和瑞典农户调查的当前实践。我们的方法具有元科学性质，依托一项针对2019年1月至2024年8月期间负责34项农户调查的研究人员的调查。该分析辅以文献分析和批判性反思研讨会。我们识别出三个关键挑战：（i）社会经济调查问题的一致性和标准化程度有限，（ii）调查篇幅过长，导致高流失率和低回复率，以及（iii）开放科学实践的采用率较低。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一套最佳实践，以增强农户调查数据的透明度、可比性、标准化和可重用性。这些最佳实践旨在加强农业经济学中基于调查的研究质量，并确保农户调查继续支持循证政策制定。

title: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
title_zh: 脸谱网上的两面性：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制
title_primary: 脸谱网上的两面性：美国众议院竞选中的广告定制
title_secondary: Two-faced on facebook: Ad tailoring in U.S. house campaigns
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Congressional candidates simultaneously seek votes from local residents and money from partisan potential donors who live across the United States. Ad targeting allows political candidates an inexpensive way not only to reach this dispersed partisan audience but also to deliver messages tailored to donors, whose preferences are more extreme than voters’. Using data on geographically-targeted Facebook ads, I find that the national ads of Democratic and Republican candidates have less issue overlap — and are more extreme — than their local, voter-targeted ads. Candidates’ ability to direct tailored, extreme communication to receptive audiences via targeted ads facilitates divergent political speech.
